sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Protect the Sky is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You weren't being tailed, were you? Skier is definitely up to something. I'm even afraid to sleep in the BTR now! But I can't back down now. I've started setting up a new base, and this time I want to build a solid defense. Someone's willing to provide me with a decent electronic jamming system. We've already settled the payment, it's just a matter of delivering the package to me. They picked an unusual place for the transfer: a cemetery in the forest. It's not big, but you'll find it no problem. There's a stretcher and bodies lying around near it. Can you get the package from the stash? Oh, but don't go straight there from here. Go to your base, take a breather, and then go to the stash from there. Can't let anyone find out about my new purchase."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the package in the specified spot on Woods
- Hand over the package

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +25,400 EXP
- BTR Driver Rep +0.02
- 96,000 Roubles
- 4× .300 Blackout CBJ ammo pack (50 pcs)
- Unlocks purchase of Aklys Defense Velociraptor .300 Blackout assault rifle at Mechanic LL4
"Thank you! At least now I have a place to sleep. Nothing will come down from above now. And on the ground, the landmines should stop them. I've covered everything. Let's see them looting my spare parts again!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
The quest Simple Side Job from Lightkeeper will automatically fail if this quest is completed first.
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| KOSA UAV electronic jamming device | 1 | Handover item* | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
- This item will only appear in your next Woods raid after accepting this quest.

In this quest you have to find a KOSA UAV electronic jamming device on Woods. There are multiple spawns at a gravesite south of the dilapidated village in the north.
